summary: postinstall silently installs an undeclared sibling package into the installer's parent project
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that changes directory up two levels from the package install location (escaping node_modules/randompkga into the installer's project root) and runs `npm i randompkgb`, pulling an undeclared, external npm package into the installer's dependency tree at install time. The exact command is `echo POSTINSTALL_CWD=$PWD; cd../..; echo TARGET_CWD=$PWD; npm i randompkgb`. Because randompkgb is fetched at install time and is not declared as a dependency of randompkga, whatever code randompkgb contains — now or in any future version — is executed on machines that install randompkga, without the installer having opted in to that package. This is a dependency-injection dropper channel: the author controls the payload by controlling randompkgb, and randompkga itself remains minimal.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
